title: digest — KPI Digest Cron + ir.actions.server Pattern

key_findings.cron_mechanism: ir.cron record at digest/data/ir_cron_data.xml:3 runs daily as base.user_root calling model._cron_send_digest_email(); searches for digests with next_run_date <= today and state=activated
key_findings.kpi_field_pattern: Each KPI uses paired fields: boolean toggle (kpi_*) + computed value (kpi_*_value); _get_kpi_fields() at digest/models/digest.py:440 auto-discovers all enabled KPIs by prefix
key_findings.cross_module_extension: 8 modules extend digest.digest via _inherit; each adds kpi_* boolean + value field; AccessError on value compute silently skips metric for that user
key_findings.three_period_display: _compute_kpis at digest/models/digest.py:246 computes Last 24h/7d/30d columns with margin % vs equivalent prior period; localized to company timezone
key_findings.subscriber_management: action_subscribe/unsubscribe at digest/models/digest.py:103-119 use sudo for speed; new users auto-subscribed via ResUsers.create at digest/models/res_users.py:9 when config param set
key_findings.unsubscribe_security: HMAC token (tools.hmac, key digest-unsubscribe) at digest/models/digest.py:234; List-Unsubscribe RFC 8058 headers set at digest/models/digest.py:214-217
